name: Question 8
problem: A particle moves along a straight line relative to a fixed origin $O$ with acceleration, measured in $\text{m}/{\text{s}}^{2},$ given by the function $a(t)=3-3{t}^{2},$ where $t⩾0$ is the time in seconds. If the particle has velocity $v=2\,\text{m}/\text{s}$ when $t=2\,\text{s},$ calculate the maximum velocity ${v}_{\text{max}}$ of the particle and determine the time whan the particle reaches its maximum velocity.

Question 8
?

A particle moves along a straight line relative to a fixed origin O with acceleration, measured in m/s2, given by the function a(t)=3−3t2, where t⩾0 is the time in seconds. If the particle has velocity v=2m/s when t=2s, calculate the maximum velocity vmax of the particle and determine the time whan the particle reaches its maximum velocity.

a
vmax=6m/s,t=1s
b
vmax=4m/s,t=0s
c
vmax=15m/s,t=2s
d
vmax=3m/s,t=0s
e
vmax=8m/s,t=1s
Submit
